adjudication.rationale: The diff removes the explicit check/error for a blank configuration in `EmbedController#ensure_embeddable` (previously `raise ... if SiteSetting.embeddable_hosts.blank?`) and replaces it with a single check `unless EmbeddableHost.host_allowed?(request.referer)` that always raises `'invalid referer host'` when no `EmbeddableHost` records exist. This doesn’t break access control (it still blocks embedding), but it does reduce diagnostic clarity by conflating “no hosts configured” with “referer mismatch,” as the finding describes.
